tools.name: get_theta
tools.description: Return current theta.json from product root

tools.name: get_anchors
tools.description: Return WGS84 home/company anchors.json

tools.name: get_error_stats
tools.description: Aggregate leave_episodes.jsonl push/label counts and lead timing

tools.name: get_leave_episode
tools.description: Push + label rows for one episode

tools.name: get_leave_window_samples
tools.description: Sparse GPS/walk samples after push (already condensed)

tools.name: get_leave_sensor_summary
tools.description: High-density wifi/cell/gps/pdr/mag semantics around t_push (NOT raw CSV). Use this instead of raw sensor dumps.

output_schema.wifi: soft set + pre/at/post Jaccard snapshots + detach events
output_schema.baro: HSMM-consumed descent/lower-platform semantics from policy history

tools.name: get_param_limits
tools.description: Return code-enforced absolute min/max and per-call step for writable params

tools.name: apply_theta_delta
tools.description: Apply one clipped theta delta and persist. enter_leave/exit_leave are HSMM P(LEAVING) thresholds; w_* are observation reliabilities.

tools.name: evaluate_theta_on_history
tools.description: Counterfactual score of current θ by replaying LeaveHsmm on stored leave-window observations (can evaluate w_*). Falls back to recorded P(LEAVING) if obs are absent.

tools.name: begin_theta_trial
tools.description: Snapshot θ before try→evaluate→revert/commit

tools.name: revert_theta_trial
tools.description: Restore θ snapshot from begin_theta_trial

tools.name: commit_theta_trial
tools.description: Accept current theta only when the C++ history-replay commit guard passes

tools.name: analyze_personalization_rules
tools.description: Deterministic ES-CRO error-signature analysis. Returns ranked causes and a semantic intervention plan; it does not change theta.

tools.name: run_constrained_theta_optimizer
tools.description: Convert semantic blocks/directions into bounded numeric candidates, replay the same HSMM, and stage the deterministic best eligible candidate. Numeric theta values are not accepted.

tools.name: run_rule_personalization
tools.description: Non-Agent baseline: deterministic rule diagnosis followed by the same candidate replay optimizer.

tools.name: get_optimization_trial
tools.description: Inspect the currently staged candidate trial and commit-guard outcomes.

tools.name: commit_optimized_theta
tools.description: Commit only the deterministic best candidate that passed all code-level guards.

tools.name: discard_optimization_trial
tools.description: Discard staged candidates without changing live theta.

tools.name: get_personalization_profile
tools.description: Return deterministic cross-episode sensor applicability and validated Agent-proposed context memory.

tools.name: propose_context_profile_update
tools.description: Propose an online-computable context memory. Code accepts only with support>=3, positive>=1, confidence>=0.65 and contradictions<=50%.

tools.name: get_context_template_catalog
tools.description: Return the only applicability, event, effect and parameter-family primitives available to Agent composition.

tools.name: generate_context_template
tools.description: Validate Agent structure, emit independent sequence observations without rewriting atomic sensors, estimate requested parameter families in C++, and replay LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH sequence reliabilities on all historical HSMM episodes.

input_schema.parameter_families: vertical_threshold, optional; departure_time disabled; Agent supplies no values

tools.name: get_context_template_trial
tools.description: Inspect the in-process replay trial before commit.

tools.name: commit_context_template
tools.description: Persist the C++-selected eligible candidate; refuses trials without a safe candidate.

tools.name: discard_context_template
tools.description: Discard the current trial without changing the active baseline.

tools.name: get_active_context_template
tools.description: Read the replay-approved profile currently consumed by SceneEngine.

tools.name: submit_agent_analysis
tools.description: Validate and persist the Agent's structured hypothesis and semantic intervention audit.

input_schema.intervention_block: context_template for current path; optional when abstain
input_schema.direction: compose for context_template; optional when abstain

tools.name: write_audit
tools.description: Append audit.jsonl entry (including no_op)

tools.name: request_anchor_reestimate
tools.description: Queue offline anchor re-inference job

tools.name: get_personalization_policy
tools.description: Return the active bounded high-level policy

tools.name: get_policy_catalog
tools.description: Return allowed templates, operators and override bounds

tools.name: begin_policy_trial
tools.description: Snapshot the active policy before a strategy experiment

tools.name: apply_policy_candidate
tools.description: Apply one validated strategy template with bounded overrides

tools.name: evaluate_policy_on_history
tools.description: Counterfactual score on labeled semantic policy_history.jsonl

tools.name: revert_policy_trial
tools.description: Restore the policy snapshot

tools.name: commit_policy_trial
tools.description: Accept the active candidate and clear the trial
